- [ASSISTANT_SAID] From Naha, one can easily take a ferry or a flight to other destinations on Okinawa Island or in the Ryukyu Islands.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The neighboring areas of Onna or Yomitan are known for beautiful beaches and rural landscapes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Onna and Yomitan are a bit further from Naha but still within a reasonable driving distance to main attractions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Renting a car allows flexibility to explore different areas of Okinawa at one's own pace.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Staying in an Airbnb provides an opportunity to experience local living and culture while having home comforts.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Travel time by bus from Naha to Onna or Yomitan typically takes about 40 to 60 minutes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The journey by monorail (Yui Rail) takes about 30 to 50 minutes, depending on the destination and stops.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Travel time may be longer during rush hour, weekends, or holidays due to increased traffic and passenger volumes.
